profile_text.body:
EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou and listed on NASDAQ under the ticker EH. On its website the company describes itself as an autonomous aerial vehicle, or AAV, technology platform company, and states that its mission is to make safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone. It says it provides AAV products and commercial solutions to customers across industries, naming urban air mobility including passenger transportation and logistics, smart city management, and aerial media solutions. The site also lists passenger transportation, logistics, emergency rescue, aerial media, and infrastructure solutions among its product areas.

The company presents itself as a forerunner of AAV technologies and commercial solutions in the global Urban Air Mobility industry. No AI-specific products, MCP servers, or lawsuits appear in the records held on the company.
